answer.reason: The supplied draft answer (B) does not match EIA's Table 1 structure for state electricity profiles. In the Delaware Electricity Profile, Table 1 breaks net generation out by sector. For the year reported in the 2024 profile, Delaware's total net generation (all sectors) is on the order of 4.7 million MWh, with independent power producers supplying the overwhelming majority; electric utilities (Delmarva Power and municipal/cooperative-owned units, whose large plants were divested or retired) generate only a very small share. The internal arithmetic confirms this: 72,718 MWh (electric utilities) plus roughly 4,653,776 MWh (independent power producers) sums to 4,726,494 MWh, showing that 4,726,494 is the all-sectors total, not the electric utilities line item. Therefore the figure listed for Electric utilities is 72,718 MWh, and the draft answer B (the all-sectors total) is incorrect.
